evidence: Matches the RPC/REST/ZMQ label and optimizes the getmempoolinfo RPC implementation.
rationale: Prevents copying the unbroadcast transaction set under lock in getmempoolinfo just to call size(). The author's benchmark shows runtime drops from ~908 µs at 10,000 IDs to ~22.6 ns, though unbroadcast sets are rarely large enough in practice for the gain to be widely felt.
